about: The epistola of the formulary “4th Sunday after Pentecost” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: Brethren: I consider that the sufferings of this time are not commensurate with the future glory, which will be revealed in us. For the expectation of creation waits for the revelation of God’s sons. For creation has been subjected to emptiness, not willingly, but because of Him who subjected it in hope; for creation itself too will be set free from the slavery of corruption into the liberty of the glory of God’s sons. For we know that every creature groans and is in labor up to now. And not only creation, but we ourselves also, having the firstfruits of the Spirit, even we groan within ourselves, awaiting the adoption of God’s sons, our body’s redemption, in Christ Jesus our Lord.
